Experimental features
Features you can try now that may change or be removed in a patch release.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

Everything here is experimental: its commands (under `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 experimental`), configuration (under `experimental` in astryx.config and in an integration manifest), output, and docs may change or be removed in any patch release, with no deprecation period. Nothing here changes what the rest of Astryx does unless you use it. A feature leaves this section when it becomes stable.

icon-sets                         [experimental] Ship an icon set: register each icon against an icon definition, so
                                  apps find icons by meaning and templates use your icons.
icon-set-files                    [experimental] Every field of the files an icon set is made of: the descriptor, the
                                  data file, and an icon definition.
